note: Resting text is each field's own localised name, via antd's `placeholder` plus `allowClear`, not a sentinel option labelled 'Clear filters'. The ink blocks are the Delta-side counterpart of island-filter-resting-text.json — same probe — so the known-issues claim that the Delta host is unaffected by the value-hiding defect can be read off a measurement rather than a cascade argument. NOTE textIsCovered: true on BOTH hosts, because antd's overlay input is the hit-test target by design. It is not the discriminator; inkFromText is.
